probability.mass: sum frozen positive rank weights by eligible class
probability.multiclass: add 0.5 to every favorable_first adverse_first no_touch mass and normalize
probability.binary: same formula over favorable_first adverse_first only
probability.multiclass_brier: sum squared probability minus one-hot outcome over all classes
probability.log_loss: negative natural logarithm of observed-class probability

continuous.weighted_quantile: stable ascending value order and first value whose cumulative positive weight is at least q times total weight
continuous.path_median: apply weighted median independently at each step after excluding only rows missing that step
continuous.central_interval_score: width plus 2/(1-coverage) times distance beyond the breached endpoint
continuous.missing_measure: exclude only from that measure denominator

calibration_and_abstention.equal_count_bins: stable ascending probability order; use min(10,max(1,floor(rows/30))) array-split bins
calibration_and_abstention.ece: row-count-weighted absolute mean-probability minus observed-frequency gap
calibration_and_abstention.novelty: strictly greater than NumPy linear 0.95 quantile after at least 250 prior scored distances
calibration_and_abstention.instability: strictly greater than 0.2 maximum-minus-minimum favorable probability across available 5 10 15 20 prefixes
calibration_and_abstention.risk_coverage: stable ascending risk score; retain ceil(requested coverage times rows), minimum one

baselines.expanding_frequency: half-smoothed prior completed registry labels only
baselines.regime_frequency: half-smoothed same-regime labels at count at least 50, otherwise explicit unconditional fallback

dependence_and_inference.unit: arithmetic mean stock loss within sorted calendar month before paired inference
dependence_and_inference.moving_block_bootstrap: overlapping non-circular length-3 blocks sampled with replacement from mean-centered paired monthly differences, concatenate and truncate to n
dependence_and_inference.diebold_mariano: raw paired mean difference divided by Newey-West standard error with Bartlett weights and lags 1 through 3; lower normal tail; no HLN correction
dependence_and_inference.holm: ascending raw p with stable name tie break; cumulative maximum of (remaining hypotheses)*p; reject only adjusted p < 0.05

coverage_tests.marginal: two-sided exact binomial test at nominal interval coverage
coverage_tests.christoffersen: likelihood-ratio Markov independence test with chi-square one degree of freedom
coverage_tests.dynamic_binary: DQ quadratic form of hit-minus-nominal on intercept and three hit lags, chi-square four degrees of freedom
